metadata.description: Region for Foundry and monitoring. Managed compute is Global: inference may run in any Azure region, including outside the United States, until Data Zone US is available.
Region for the AI Gateway (preview regions only).
Short lowercase prefix for resource names.
Model to deploy, a key of catalog.json models.
Hardware option for the model, a key of its catalog.json options (a100, h100, 2xa100, 2xh100 or mi300x). Empty uses the model's cheapest option.
Model instances. Each instance is billed every hour for its accelerators. Global quota is 8 accelerators per family.
Optional extra Entra object ID (user, group or service principal) to grant access. The account that runs the deployment always gets access.
Type of principalId.

Capture request and response payloads in gateway traces. Off by default, so prompt and completion text is not stored. Turning it on adds token usage (gen_ai.usage.*) and model attributes to traces and stores prompt and completion text in Application Insights.
Monthly budget for this resource group, in the billing currency. 0 uses the estimated monthly cost plus 10%, rounded up to the next 100. Alerts fire at 80% of actual spend and 100% of forecast spend.
Optional email address for budget alerts. Resource group owners are always notified.
First day of the budget period. New budgets must start in the current month, and Azure cannot change the start date later, so when you redeploy in a later month pass the original start date.
Web page that shows next steps for this deployment. The deployment appends its values to the URL fragment.

Sovereign AI site endpoint that records when this deployment starts and finishes, so the site can follow it and list it under Your deployments. Sends the tenant, subscription, resource group and deployment names, your Entra object ID and the next-steps values. Leave empty to turn off.
Reports are sent only for deployments in this Entra tenant (BRK Commons), so deployments elsewhere send nothing.
Unique value for each run, so Azure fetches the report URL again on redeploys.

variables.globalNotice: Global deployment: inference may run in any Azure region, including outside the United States, until Data Zone US is available.
variables.pinningNotice: Model weights are pinned to a tested release. The serving template (runtime, GPUs, context) follows Microsoft's latest; verify-catalog.sh flags when it moves from the tested version.
variables.stopBillingCommand: [format('az rest --method delete --url "{0}" && while az rest --method get --url "{1}" -o none 2>/dev/null; do sleep 30; done && az group delete --subscription {2} -n {3} && az cognitiveservices account purge --subscription {4} -l {5} -g {6} -n {7}', variables('managedDeploymentUrl'), variables('managedDeploymentUrl'), subscription().subscriptionId, resourceGroup().name, subscription().subscriptionId, parameters('location'), resourceGroup().name, variables('modelAccountName'))]
